about.hero.title: A capital-markets technology company, engineered from Dubai for the emerging world.
about.hero.lede: We build regulator-grade infrastructure for exchanges, regulators, banks, brokers and issuers across Africa and the Gulf. Our platform, CCMI, is the operating system of the modern emerging-market exchange.
about.mission.body: To compress the operational distance between frontier and developed capital markets — with the discipline of an exchange, the pragmatism of an operator, and the ambition of a founder.
about.vision.body: By 2030, one in every two African listed issuers runs on CCMI — and Dubai stands as the undisputed technology corridor to the continent.

inv.sec.vision.body: By 2030, one in every two African listed issuers runs on CCMI. Our Series A capital funds three new exchange deployments and a doubling of our Dubai engineering team.

inv.sec.market.body: Total addressable market for capital-markets technology across MENA + Africa is projected at USD 18B by 2030 (Oliver Wyman, 2025). Our SAM is USD 6.4B — the modernisation-ready segment we serve today.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.s1.p: MK Capital Markets Technologies Ltd, registered in DIFC, Dubai, is the data controller for personal data collected via this website and our platforms.
legal.privacy.s2.p: Contact-form data (name, professional email, organisation), platform usage logs, cookies (see Cookie Policy), and — for investor data-room access — identity verification data as required by AML/KYC obligations.
legal.privacy.s3.p: We rely on legitimate interest for prospect communications, consent for marketing cookies and newsletter, contractual necessity for client-facing services, and legal obligation for AML/KYC and record-keeping.
legal.privacy.s4.p: Prospect data is retained up to 24 months from last interaction. Client data follows the terms of our Master Services Agreement. Regulatory logs are retained for 7 years.
legal.privacy.s5.p: Data is stored in Azure regions in the UAE and the EU. Cross-border transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses aligned with GDPR and DIFC DP Law.
legal.privacy.s6.p: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and objection. Contact privacy@mkcmt.io. You may also lodge a complaint with the DIFC Commissioner of Data Protection.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.s1.p: These terms govern your use of the mkcmt.io website and its sub-domains. Platform usage (CCMI) is governed by a separate Master Services Agreement.
legal.terms.s2.p: You agree not to attempt to circumvent security controls, scrape content beyond the terms of our robots.txt, or use the service to infringe intellectual property.
legal.terms.s3.p: All content, trademarks and CCMI product design are the property of MK Capital Markets Technologies Ltd. Fair use for citation is permitted with attribution.
legal.terms.s4.p: The website is provided as-is. To the maximum extent permitted by law, MK Capital Markets Technologies excludes liability for indirect damages arising from website use.
legal.terms.s5.p: These terms are governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the DIFC Courts.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.s1.p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device to remember your preferences and improve your experience.
legal.cookies.s2.p: Essential (session, security, load balancing) — always enabled. Analytics (Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity) — subject to consent. Marketing (LinkedIn Insight, Meta Pixel) — subject to consent.
legal.cookies.s3.p: Use the cookie banner at your first visit, or the preferences link in the footer, to adjust your choices at any time. Rejection does not restrict access to public content.
legal.cookies.s4.p: Certain third parties (Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Meta) set cookies under their own privacy policies. Please refer to their notices for details.
legal.cookies.s5.p: Our cookie management is aligned with the IAB TCF 2.2 framework and DIFC DP Law 2020.
